turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Here is the rule: with no action word, use am, is or are: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are.
Right: "The giraffe is very tall." Wrong: "The giraffe very tall." The wrong one has no action word and no is, so the sentence is not complete.
Let me think aloud: "The zebra is black and white." Who? The zebra, one animal, so it. It goes with is.
Now your turn. First find who, then choose. Write am, is or are:
I ___ a student. (answer with only the missing word)
